status: Validated against primary sources current on 2026-10-16, five consultation rounds and one matched trial per arm.
request: Review the skills and decide whether they need updating; apply the approved updates and open a PR from origin/main. This change corrects github-actions claims GitHub changed after 2026-08-22 and adds platform changes that alter what an agent should do.

changes.change: Dependency procedure: Node 24 is the only JavaScript runtime on GitHub.com (replace node20 releases; macOS <= 13.4 and ARM32 self-hosted runners unsupported); SHA pins outside onboarded workflows; workflow lockfile handling per workflow (scoped gh actions-lock regeneration, --relock and --accept-moved, keep tool rewrites, fix kept ./ action references before onboarding and check the workflows section for empty entries, since they block an onboarded workflow, owner_id and repo_id investigation, --verify). actionlint 1.7.12 rejects valid current syntax, so confirm such errors against GitHub Docs. Retention changes route to the artifact section.

Default pull_request_target policy for public repositories (evaluate mode until 2026-11-02 only for repositories on the default before GA); lockfile coverage, local-action migration and allowlist effects; vulnerability-alerts permission; cache-mode access levels and the reusable-workflow validation failure; retention now deletes checks, runs and statuses; self-hosted runner version enforcement since 2026-09-29; execution protections GA.
actions/github-script v9.0.0 pinned at 3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 with its two breaking changes; a lockfile entry also counts as a pin.

Fork runs awaiting approval for more than 30 days expire and are marked failed; the default pull_request_target policy in the execution-protection gate; matrix example node: [22, 24]; job.workflow_repository and job.workflow_sha for a called workflow's own checkout; caller cache-mode caps a called workflow.

Egress allowlist blocks registries defined only in package-manager files; Anonymous organization registries; GitHub Packages and ghcr.io through the package's Actions access grant; Dependabot regenerates lockfile entries for onboarded workflows; egress log lines in diagnosis.
Cache consumers use cache-mode: read; the linter-lag rule lives only in SKILL.md; current source URLs.
Refreshed the github-actions entrypoint hash and the catalog cache key.
